usage.outputShape: body.city, body.country, body.latitude, body.longitude, body.days[] (each: date, condition, weather_code, temp_max_c, temp_min_c, precipitation_mm, precipitation_probability_pct, wind_max_kmh)
usage.guide: Call GET https://weather.hugen.tokyo/weather/forecast with x402 payment (~$0.01 USDC on Base). All query params are optional: pass city (e.g. ?city=Tokyo) for a city lookup, or lat & lon for coordinates; days (1-7, default 3) sets the forecast horizon. The response is a flat JSON object — read city/country/latitude/longitude off the top level and iterate body.days[] for the daily forecast (date, condition human-readable string, weather_code, temp_max_c, temp_min_c, precipitation_mm, precipitation_probability_pct, wind_max_kmh). Plain synchronous request; no auth header or polling needed.
